grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Weekend Trip to Suzhou: Listening and Grammar Practice
instructions: 这是一份为A2水平学习者设计的原创听力与语法练习材料，场景为模拟的旅行经历分享。请先听录音（或阅读transcript），然后完成16道题目。题目类型包括单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: Last weekend, I went to Suzhou with my friend, Li Ming. Suzhou is a beautiful city near Shanghai, and it is famous for its gardens and silk. We took the train from Shanghai. The trip was about thirty minutes, so it was very quick and easy. We left early in the morning and arrived in Suzhou before lunch. First, we visited the Humble Administrator's Garden. It was very beautiful. The garden was large and quiet, with trees, water, and old buildings. We walked around the garden and took many photos. We also saw many other visitors there. Then, we felt hungry, so we ate lunch at a small restaurant near the garden. The restaurant was clean and the food was good. I had noodles and Li Ming had rice. After that, we went to a silk shop. The shop had many beautiful things, and we bought a silk scarf for my mother. Finally, we went back to the train station. We were tired but very happy. On the train, Li Ming said, "I want to go again next month." I said, "Me too!" But then I remembered I have to work next month. So I said, "Maybe next year."

grammar.title: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加-ed，例如：visit → visited, walk → walked。不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，例如：go → went, take → took, eat → ate, buy → bought, have → had, be (am/is) → was, are → were。表示顺序时，可以用 first, then, after that, finally 等词。
grammar.example: First, we visited the Humble Administrator's Garden. Then, we ate lunch. After that, we went to a silk shop. Finally, we went back to the train station.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: Yesterday, I ______ to the park.
questions.explanation: go的过去式是went，不规则变化。
questions.evidence: Last weekend, I went to Suzhou with my friend, Li Ming.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: She ______ a new dress last week.
questions.explanation: buy的过去式是bought，不规则变化。
questions.evidence: We bought a silk scarf for my mother.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We visited the museum. ______, we had dinner.
questions.explanation: 表示然后，用then。
questions.evidence: Then, we felt hungry, so we ate lunch at a small restaurant near the garden.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: They ______ happy at the party.
questions.explanation: they的过去式be动词是were。
questions.evidence: We were tired but very happy.
